title: Floweil
description: A toolkit for connecting the virtual world with the physical.
body:
# TeaTech
The TeaTech modpack is a combination of mods cherry-picked to work seemlessly around the [IoTcraft](https://modrinth.com/project/iotcraft) mod.

## Contents
- **IoTcraft**: Allows for the connection between Minecraft and any IoT device.
- **Create** (and a lot of addons for it): The main content of this modpack.
- **Optimization mods**: Provide a boost to almost any machine, increasing performance.
- **Libraries**: Small mods required by other mods in the modpack.
